stage_2_selection.summary: QUB ranks standard Home applicants for interview using GCSE points plus UCAT decile points. This is an interview-invitation prediction only.

historical_context.warning: QUB has not published an official 2026 interview threshold. Historical point thresholds are context only, not official current cut-offs; ApplySmart derives band labels and labels them as derived.

prediction.band_basis: Interview Prediction Band (ApplySmart derived): Strong. The score scale and formula are official QUB methodology; the band label is not an official QUB cut-off.

applysmart_predictive_modelling: Historical guidance calibration is context only and not an official 2026 threshold

confidence.summary: Methodology confidence is High because QUB publishes the GCSE scoring, UCAT scoring, combined formula and 45-point maximum. Prediction calibration confidence is Medium because the 2026 interview threshold is unpublished and the band label is derived.

evidence_confidence.summary: The recommendation is supported by core admissions evidence, with some historical or route-specific limits.
